source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nucleophilic substitution (PDF 79-81).

blocks.text: Nucleophilic substitution mein do amal hote hain: leaving group nikalta (C-X bond toot'ta) aur nucleophile hamla karta (C-Nu bond banta). Agar dono aik hi qadam mein saath hon to mechanism SN2 hai. Agar do alag qadmon mein hon, pehle bond tootna phir bond banna, to mechanism SN1 hai.

SN2 aik qadmi mechanism hai. Jaise hi nucleophile electrophilic carbon par hamla shuru karta hai, leaving group wala bond tootna shuru ho jata hai; bond banna aur tootna saath saath chalte hain. Nucleophile leaving group ki mukhalif simt se hamla karta hai.

blocks.alt: OH- se bromomethane ke delta+ carbon ki taraf mura teer, Br ki mukhalif simt se hamla, aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mura teer. Phir bracket mein transition state HO---C---Br, manfi charge ke saath; phir methanol jis ke teen H doosri taraf palat gaye (O par delta-, C par delta+) + Br-.
blocks.caption: SN2 mechanism: bromomethane aur hydroxide ion (kitab ke PDF safha 79 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke SN2 khaake mein sirf OH- se carbon tak ka mura teer chhapa hai; C-Br bond ke electrons Br par jane ka teer ghayab hai. Hamare khaake mein yeh doosra teer bhi hai, kyunke aik hi qadam mein naya bond banta aur purana bond toot'ta hai. Product mein teeno H doosri taraf palat jate hain, jaise tez hawa mein chhatri ulat jati hai (inversion).

Kyunke is aik (rate tay karne wale) qadam mein do molecules shamil hain, reaction bimolecular hai, aur is ki raftaar dono concentrations par munhasir hai: rate = k[halogenoalkane][nucleophile], is liye yeh second order (1 + 1 = 2) hai.

Primary halogenoalkanes nucleophiles ke hamle par SN2 se react karte hain. Is ki wajah steric hai: carbon par hydrogen atoms ya sirf aik alkyl group hota hai, is liye nucleophile aasani se us tak pohanch kar hamla kar sakta hai.

SN1 ke do qadam hain. Pehle halogenoalkane aabi acetone ya aabi ethanol jaise solvent mein ulat sakne wale tareeqe se ionise ho kar carbocation darmiyani halat deta hai. Doosre, nucleophile carbocation par hamla kar ke product deta hai. Pehla qadam covalent bond torta hai, is liye sust hai; doosra, mukhalif charge wale ions ka milna, tez hai. Sust pehla qadam rate tay karta aur is mein sirf aik molecule hai, is liye mechanism unimolecular hai: rate = k[halogenoalkane], first order.

blocks.alt: Pehla qadam: (H3C)3C-Br, C par delta+ aur Br par delta-, equilibrium teeron (slow) se satah wala (planar) carbocation + Br- deta hai. Doosra qadam: carbocation + OH-, OH- se musbat carbon ki taraf mura teer, tez (fast), (H3C)3C-OH deta hai (Product).
blocks.caption: SN1 mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 80 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle qadam mein do teer (equilibrium) hain kyunke ionisation ulat sakti (reversible) hai; yeh qadam sust (slow) hai aur rate tay karta hai. Carbocation ka musbat carbon satah wala (planar) hai, is liye OH- kisi bhi taraf se hamla kar sakta hai.

Tertiary halogenoalkanes nucleophiles ke hamle par SN1 se react karte hain. Asal wajah yeh hai ke yeh mustahkam tertiary carbocation banate hain; saath hi electrophilic carbon par teen bhari groups nucleophile ko leaving group ke peeche se hamla karne se rokte hain. Secondary halogenoalkane solvent ke mutabiq SN2 ya SN1 kisi se bhi react kar sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar carbocations is tarteeb mein: tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl. Har musbat carbon apne groups ke saath; CH3 groups ke bonds par laal teer carbon ki taraf. Tertiary par teen CH3, secondary par do, primary par aik aur methyl carbocation par koi nahi.
blocks.caption: Musbat inductive effect (+I) ke kam hone se carbocations ke istehkaam (stability) ki ghat'ti tarteeb (kitab ke PDF safha 80 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har CH3 group apne electrons musbat carbon ki taraf dhakelta hai (laal teer, +I effect) aur us ka musbat charge kuch kam kar deta hai. Jitne zyada CH3 groups, utna mustahkam carbocation: tertiary (3) > secondary (2) > primary (1) > methyl (0).

blocks.prompt: Tertiary halogenoalkanes SN1 se aur primary SN2 se kyun react karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Tertiary: teen alkyl groups carbocation ko mustahkam karte aur peeche se hamla rokte. Primary: carbocation na-mustahkam hota, lekin carbon par bheer nahi, is liye nucleophile aik qadam mein seedha hamla kar sakta.

items: SN2: aik qadam, peeche se hamla, rate = k[RX][Nu], primary halogenoalkanes.
SN1: sust ionisation se carbocation, phir tez hamla; rate = k[RX], tertiary halogenoalkanes.
Carbocation istehkaam: tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl.
